text: Existing OpenAI SDK code works unchanged by just pointing base_url to DeepInfra's endpoint
quote: Drop-in OpenAI replacement. Point your existing OpenAI SDK to https://api.deepinfra.com/v1/openai and your code works without changes.

text: OpenAI-compatible chat completions API — swap base URL and model name only
quote: OpenAI-compatible chat completions API — just change the base URL and model name.

text: Three-step migration: set base_url, api_key, and model to use existing OpenAI code
quote:
The only changes you need to make from your existing OpenAI code:

1.  Set `base_url` to `https://api.deepinfra.com/v1/openai`
2.  Set `api_key` to your DeepInfra token
3.  Set `model` to a model from our catalog

text: Supports multi-turn conversations by including full message history in each request
quote: To create a longer conversation, include the full message history in every request. The model uses this context to provide better answers.

text: Priority service tier gives faster time-to-first-token and higher throughput under load
quote: Set service_tier to "priority" to request priority inference on supported models. Priority requests get faster time-to-first-token and higher throughput during peak demand.

text: Flex tier offers lower-cost inference for non-production workloads like evals, enrichment, async jobs
quote: It’s ideal for non-production or lower-priority tasks such as model evaluations, data enrichment, and asynchronous workloads.

text: Flex tier is billed at a 20% discount off standard per-token pricing
quote: Flex inference is billed at a 20% discount off the model's standard per-token price.

text: fail_fast parameter returns immediate HTTP 429 instead of queuing the request
quote: Set the optional fail_fast parameter to true to get an immediate HTTP 429 instead of waiting.

text: reasoning_effort parameter controls reasoning depth for reasoning models
quote: reasoning_effort Controls reasoning depth for reasoning models. See Reasoning Models.

text: Deploy your own fine-tuned LLM on dedicated GPUs (A100/H100/H200/B200/B300) with autoscaling and a private endpoint
quote: Need to run your own fine-tuned weights, or require data isolation? Deploy a dedicated instance on A100/H100/H200/B200/B300 with autoscaling and a private endpoint

text: Rent bare-metal B200/B300 GPU clusters with SSH access for training and full control
quote: GPU Clusters for training and full control. Rent a B200 or B300 cluster with SSH access and run whatever you want.

text: Pay-per-token pricing with no idle GPU time, minimums, or seat fees
quote: You only pay per token — no idle GPU time, no minimums, no seat fees.

text: Low pay-as-you-go pricing with no long-term contracts or hidden fees, scaling from startup to enterprise
quote: Low pay-as-you-go pricing - no long-term contracts, no hidden fees, no surprises. Startup? Enterprise? We can scale.

text: Offers image and video generation models such as FLUX, Stable Diffusion, and text-to-video
quote: FLUX, Stable Diffusion, text-to-video, and more.
